evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rose steadily from 5.5 to 39.1 ppm between t=2520 and t=3240. After purge and through the ramp it had been flat at about 5 ppm.
Argon flow held at 100 sccm, so the O2 rise is not explained by lower flow.
Temperature held at 750 °C and heater power was steady at about 45%, so thermal control looks normal.
No pressure gauge is installed, which growth requires, so tube pressure cannot be checked.

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure, to tell a seal leak (pressure normal or low) from an exhaust blockage (pressure rising). A leak check on the tube seals. Any characterization of the sample.
